notice: SYNTHETIC DATA. Written for this take-home because the Bain-provided knowledge base was not available. These records are fictional and do not describe real claims, people or payouts.

claims.description: Flexible hose under the kitchen sink burst overnight. Water spread across the kitchen and hallway, swelling laminate flooring and the lower cabinet panels. Water reached the apartment below.
evidence: plumber invoice identifying failed flexible hose
claims.resolution_notes: Sudden and accidental escape of water. Flooring and cabinets replaced; third-party ceiling repair handled under liability section.

claims.cause: slow leak from shower tray seal
claims.description: Claimant reported a brown stain on the living room ceiling below the bathroom and a musty smell. Inspection found the shower tray seal had been leaking for months; joists were damp and plaster was crumbling.
claims.resolution_notes: Gradual leakage over months is excluded; only accidental ceiling plaster damage covered. Resealing considered maintenance.

claims.cause: water escaping from upstairs neighbour washing machine
claims.description: Water came through the bathroom and bedroom ceiling from the flat above after a washing machine hose came loose. Ceiling plaster sagging, light fitting filled with water, electricity tripped in the bedroom circuit.
evidence: video of water dripping from light fitting
claims.resolution_notes: Emergency electrician dispatched same day due to water in light fitting. Recovery pursued against neighbour's insurer.

claims.description: During a cold spell a pipe in the uninsulated loft froze and burst. Water poured through the upstairs ceilings into two bedrooms; carpets, a mattress and a wardrobe were soaked. Mains water was shut off by the claimant.
claims.resolution_notes: Drying equipment installed for 10 days. Ceilings re-boarded. Contents settled from inventory.

claims.cause: sprinkler head failure in retail unit
claims.description: A sprinkler head in a clothing shop failed and discharged water for about 20 minutes before being shut off. Stock on the lower shelves and the suspended ceiling tiles were damaged. Shop closed for two days.
claims.resolution_notes: Business interruption for two days included. Stock valued at cost price.

claims.description: Small dishwasher leak noticed in the morning. Water pooled under the appliance and lifted two floor tiles near the kitchen island. No damage to other rooms.
claims.resolution_notes: Fast-track desk settlement after photo review. Excess of 150 EUR applied.

claims.description: Torrential rain caused the street to flood and muddy water entered the ground floor to a depth of 40 cm. Sofa, kitchen units, washing machine and wall plaster damaged. Family moved to relatives for a week.
claims.resolution_notes: Alternative accommodation paid for 7 nights. Coordinated with the public flood compensation consortium for part of the loss.

claims.description: River overflow flooded a ground-floor warehouse with 80 cm of water. Pallets of packaged goods, a forklift and electrical panels were submerged. Power disconnected by the utility.
claims.resolution_notes: Major loss team appointed. Electrical panels replaced before reconnection. Salvage of part of the stock.

claims.description: Basement walls show tide marks and water seeps in every time it rains heavily. Claimant reports stored boxes ruined. Inspection found long-standing failure of the basement waterproofing.
evidence: photos of efflorescence and tide marks
claims.resolution_notes: Repeated seepage due to failed waterproofing is a gradual, maintenance-related issue and is excluded.

claims.description: A severe windstorm tore off roughly a third of the roof tiles and part of the ridge. Rain entered the attic overnight and stained the bedroom ceiling. Tarpaulin installed by a roofer the next morning.
claims.resolution_notes: Emergency tarpaulin reimbursed. Wind speed above policy threshold confirmed by weather data.

claims.cause: tree fell on garage during storm
claims.description: A large pine tree from the garden fell during the storm and crushed part of the detached garage roof and the car parked inside. No injuries.
claims.resolution_notes: Garage structure and tree removal covered. Vehicle damage redirected to the motor policy.

claims.description: Strong gusts blew in a living-room window that had not been closed properly. Broken glass and rain damaged the parquet near the window.
claims.resolution_notes: Glass and parquet section replaced. Advice given on securing windows during storm warnings.

claims.description: Hailstorm cracked several polycarbonate skylights, dented the metal gutters and shredded the garden awning. Water entered through one cracked skylight onto the kitchen floor.
evidence: photos of hailstones next to coin
claims.resolution_notes: Skylights replaced, awning settled at depreciated value.

claims.description: Hail damaged the solar panels on the roof of an agricultural warehouse. Several panels show cracked glass and output dropped by 40 percent.
claims.resolution_notes: Panels replaced; production logs used to confirm date of loss.

claims.cause: roof leak attributed to worn flashing
claims.description: Claimant reports water dripping into the attic during rain. Roofer found corroded chimney flashing and moss-covered, slipped tiles; no storm recorded on the reported date.
evidence: photos of moss and slipped tiles
claims.resolution_notes: Wear and tear and lack of maintenance are excluded. No insured storm event on the date.

claims.cause: roof partially collapsed under accumulated snow
claims.description: Heavy snow accumulated on a flat garage roof which partially collapsed. Beams cracked and the roof deck sagged; access to the garage was prohibited by the claimant's builder.
claims.resolution_notes: Temporary propping installed within 24h. Roof rebuilt to current snow-load standards.

claims.description: Top-floor apartment reports damp patches and peeling paint on the bedroom ceiling after rain. The community roof terrace membrane is cracked.
claims.resolution_notes: Interior repainting covered; membrane repair is the responsibility of the building community insurer.

claims.cause: kitchen fire from unattended frying pan
claims.description: Oil in a frying pan caught fire. Flames damaged the extractor hood, upper cabinets and ceiling; smoke blackened the kitchen and living room. Fire brigade attended; the house was unsafe to occupy for three weeks.
claims.resolution_notes: Alternative accommodation for 3 weeks. Specialist smoke cleaning for whole ground floor.

claims.description: An overloaded extension lead behind the TV melted and started a small fire that scorched the wall, skirting board and a TV cabinet. Claimant extinguished it with a fire blanket.
evidence: melted extension lead kept as evidence
claims.resolution_notes: Electrician confirmed wiring safe after the event. Redecoration and cabinet replacement settled.

claims.cause: fire of undetermined origin in outbuilding
claims.description: A storage outbuilding burned down at night. Claimant increased contents cover two weeks before and claims high-value tools and equipment, with no purchase receipts available.
evidence: list of claimed items without receipts
claims.resolution_notes: Referred to the special investigations unit due to recent cover increase, undetermined origin and lack of ownership evidence.

claims.description: Grease build-up in the extraction duct of a restaurant ignited. Fire spread into the ceiling void; the dining area suffered heavy smoke damage. Restaurant closed for five weeks.
evidence: duct cleaning records (last cleaned 14 months ago)
claims.resolution_notes: Settlement reduced because duct cleaning was overdue versus policy condition (every 6 months).

claims.description: A fire in the adjacent apartment sent smoke through the shared ventilation shaft. Walls and curtains are stained with soot and there is a persistent smoke odour. No fire inside the insured flat.
evidence: fire brigade report for adjacent flat
claims.resolution_notes: Specialist cleaning and repainting. Recovery from neighbour's insurer pursued.

claims.description: Nearby wildfire deposited ash on the property; smoke entered through open windows. Claimant reports odour in upholstery and ash in the pool filtration system.
claims.resolution_notes: Cleaning costs covered. Pool equipment cleaning included.

claims.description: Diagonal cracks wider than 5 mm appeared above doors and windows on the rear wall. Doors stick and a gap opened between the floor and skirting. Clay soil with a large tree nearby.
claims.resolution_notes: Underpinning of rear wall after monitoring confirmed active movement. Tree removed.

claims.description: Claimant noticed thin hairline cracks in plaster in a newly extended room. Engineer found normal shrinkage and settlement of new construction; no structural movement.
claims.resolution_notes: Shrinkage and settlement of new structures is excluded. Cosmetic only.

claims.description: A van reversed into a shopfront, shattering the glazing and cracking a supporting column. The building manager restricted access until an engineer inspected.
claims.resolution_notes: Emergency boarding and propping same day. Full recovery from the driver's motor insurer.

claims.description: Black mould on bedroom walls and behind wardrobes. Poor ventilation and drying laundry indoors. No identifiable leak.
claims.resolution_notes: Condensation and mould without an insured water escape are excluded. Ventilation advice provided.

claims.cause: mould following an undetected pipe leak
claims.description: Mould spread inside a kitchen wall after a concealed pipe joint leaked. Plaster opened to find wet insulation and mould growth on timber studs.
claims.resolution_notes: Mould remediation covered as consequence of an accidental escape of water; trace-and-access costs included.

claims.description: Intruders forced the rear door of an office, smashed glass partitions and sprayed graffiti on walls. Laptops were stolen.
claims.resolution_notes: Door secured within 4 hours. Theft settled under contents section.

claims.description: Graffiti sprayed on the front facade and garage door overnight. No forced entry.
claims.resolution_notes: Fast-track settlement for specialist cleaning.

claims.description: Electric water heater in the utility room ruptured, releasing 80 litres of hot water. Water ran under the wall into the bedroom; wooden floor buckled and the socket near the floor got wet.
claims.resolution_notes: Floor replaced; the heater itself not covered (mechanical breakdown).

claims.cause: leak claimed but no damage evident
claims.description: Claimant reported a water leak in the bathroom with large damage to flooring, but submitted photos show dry, intact tiles and the plumber invoice is dated before the policy start.
claims.resolution_notes: Evidence inconsistent with the declared damage; invoice predates inception. Closed after interview.

claims.cause: storm damage to terrace and awning
claims.description: Strong winds tore the terrace awning off its fixings and overturned heavy planters, cracking terrace tiles and a glass balustrade panel.
claims.resolution_notes: Balustrade panel replaced urgently for safety; awning settled with depreciation.

claims.cause: storm lifted roof tiles, rain ingress into bedroom
claims.description: After a storm with strong winds, several roof tiles were displaced. Rain entered and a brown water stain appeared on the bedroom ceiling, with plaster bubbling around the light fitting.
claims.resolution_notes: Tiles refixed within 48h to stop ingress; ceiling replastered after drying.

claims.description: Coastal storm surge pushed seawater and sand into a beachfront restaurant. Refrigeration units and the terrace decking were damaged.
evidence: photos of sand and debris inside
claims.resolution_notes: Coordinated with catastrophe consortium. Refrigeration replaced; decking repaired.

claims.description: Lightning struck the chimney during a thunderstorm and ignited the roof timbers. Fire brigade extinguished it; roof void and upper floor heavily damaged by fire and firefighting water.
claims.resolution_notes: Major loss team. Temporary roof installed within 48h. Family rehoused for 4 months.

claims.description: Condensate drain from the split air-conditioning unit blocked and dripped down the wall, staining paint and swelling the skirting board in the living room.
claims.resolution_notes: Desk settlement for repainting and skirting.

claims.cause: retaining wall collapse after heavy rain
claims.description: A garden retaining wall collapsed after two days of heavy rain, pushing soil against the side of the house and cracking an exterior wall. The side path is blocked.
claims.resolution_notes: Wall had inadequate drainage; house damage covered, wall rebuild partially covered.

claims.description: Extreme rainfall flooded the whole ground floor to 1.2 metres. Electrical installation, boiler, kitchen and all ground-floor furniture destroyed. House declared uninhabitable; elderly occupant evacuated.
claims.resolution_notes: Vulnerable occupant: welfare call and emergency advance payment within 72h. Coordinated with catastrophe consortium.

claims.cause: bathroom pipe leak through ceiling to flat below
claims.description: Pipe joint behind the bathroom wall failed. Water stained and softened the ceiling of the flat below around the ceiling light; plaster bulging. Claimant shut off water and called a plumber the same day.
claims.resolution_notes: Electrical isolation of the ceiling light advised as precaution. Repairs settled in 3 weeks.
